text: Title commitment: a 2011 reverse mortgage (HECM) with about $190,000 owed.

At $200,000, the heirs net nearly nothing after the payoff. HUD rules let heirs sell for the lesser of the balance or 95% of appraised value; the servicer needs an appraisal and payoff approval. Timeline: 30-60 more days.

Title found the reverse mortgage. Our price stays $200,000; the servicer must approve the payoff, which usually takes 30-60 days. We'll keep our offer open while that happens. Please let us know whether the family wants to go ahead.
note: Honest: no pressure to accept less.

text: Payoff and approval requested through counsel; deadlines tracked; buyer #4 told of a 45-day delay and agreed (Dispositions).
Servicer approved the payoff at $190,000. Closing set for 2027-03-20.
note: Back on the main path; heirs net about $5,000, which counsel explained to them.
